source_rationale: Summary of CAR-Treg representation in infusion product cells of this dataset (n=28 biologically independent samples with ≥100 cells) as well as b, an independent set of axi-cel infusion products (n=24 biologically independent samples). Shown are a u-map representation of cells colored by FOXP3 expression (left) and the fraction of identified CAR-Tregs (out of all CAR-T cells) stratified by product and response (right).
